TRIPS is a point-based radiance field rendering technique that rasterizes points into a screen-space image pyramid using trilinear splats, followed by a neural reconstruction network to produce hole-free, crisp images [S2].

The source explicitly states that TRIPS is a 'point-based radiance field rendering technique' that 'rasterize[s] the point cloud as 2x2x2 trilinear splats into an image pyramid' and subsequently feeds this into a 'compact neural reconstruction network' to produce 'hole-free and crisp images'. All specific technical details mentioned in the claim (trilinear splats, image pyramid, neural reconstruction, hole-free/crisp output) are directly supported by the text.
